title: Departure log
ownerOnlyNotice: Only an owner can generate a departure's log. Everything it draws on — roll call, timeline, each diver's status — is on that departure's manifest.
description: What was recorded for this departure — boarding, roll-call timeline, certification evidence, waiver status — written up as one document, ready to print if authorities or insurers ever ask.
factsOnly: This document reports recorded facts with their timestamps. It does not assess, certify, or imply any safety judgment.
checklistEmpty: This shop has no pre-departure checklist defined.
rosterDescription: Every active booking with its result at each checkpoint. “Awaiting roll call” means no result was recorded — an absence is stated, never left blank. Buddy team is the grouping recorded for this departure, not per dive; a blank is not a statement that anyone dived alone.
buddyPairedByUnknown: Recorder and time not on record
crewNone: No crew was assigned to this departure.
executedDiveDescription: What the crew recorded after each dive, including an explicit absence where a field was not captured.
executedDiveEmpty: No post-dive record has been saved.
evidenceDescription: Certification records as held when this document was generated, with review dates. Waiver status only — medical answers are never part of this document.
waiverCompleteAttested: Recorded by staff from an in-person signature.
waiverPaperMarkedBy: Recorded by {name} from an in-person signature.
waiverCompleteImported: Imported acceptance from a prior system — not signed through this shop’s own release.
waiverNotSigned: No current signed waiver on record.
waiverPending: A waiver link was issued and has not been signed.
waiverMedicalReview: Medical review flagged as required — status only; the questionnaire’s answers are not part of this document.
timelineDescription: Every roll-call entry for this departure, oldest first. Entries are append-only, so a correction adds a line and never rewrites one.
timelineEmpty: No roll-call entries have been recorded for this departure.
footerHashExplainer: Computed from this document's recorded facts. Re-generating from unchanged records reproduces the same code, so two copies can be checked against each other.
certSelfDeclaredTag: self-declared by the diver, never verified
